name: turbo-ai-form-filler
description: AI-powered Chrome extension that auto-fills job application forms on LinkedIn, Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, and more

scripts.bundle: npx esbuild dist/content.js --bundle --outfile=dist/content.bundle.js --format=iife --platform=browser && npx esbuild dist/popup.js --bundle --outfile=dist/popup.bundle.js --format=iife --platform=browser && npx esbuild dist/options.js --bundle --outfile=dist/options.bundle.js --format=iife --platform=browser
